::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/reports"}
#docs
A client renders a report it has never heard of from this plus the answer envelope, which is the point: a catalogue with its own copy of what exists will eventually offer a report the engine has dropped, or hide one it has gained.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The reports that can be run. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such business |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/reports" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

}
